dedupe_keys.name: banks at the chokepoint cross country dataset on bank equity losses and recovery across five energy and maritime chokepoint disruptions 2019 2026

description: An analysis-ready bank and event panel on how national exposure to energy and maritime chokepoints relates to bank share price losses and recovery after five disruptions: the 2019 Abqaiq-Khurais attacks, the 2021 Suez Canal blockage, Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, the 2024 Red Sea escalation and the 2026 Strait of Hormuz shock. The Mendeley Data record says exposure is measured from pre-event trade shares of HS 27 (mineral fuel) imports, and the workbook holds event definitions, exposure measures, macro controls, the bank universe, daily event-study panels, abnormal returns, drawdowns, recovery timing, Kaplan-Meier and Cox model results and complete source and API logs; the main balanced sample has 95 banks from 26 countries (475 bank-event observations). Prices are from Yahoo Finance, trade from UN Comtrade and controls from Our World in Data and the World Bank. Version 1 was published on 10 August 2026 by Ekrem Yilmaz as an Excel workbook of about 77 MB, R code and a README, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: listed banks only, and market-model results depend on estimation windows. For simulation it gives event-based financial sector responses to supply chokepoint shocks, to calibrate transmission from energy and shipping disruption to banks.
